types.description: HDC HVE 10+2 MS male screw insert, size 8; 10 power + 2 pilot + aggregate PE

modelingNotes: Exact order 1651350000, HDC HVE 10+2 MS: male screw insert, size 8, ten power contacts plus two pilot/signal contacts and PE. No housing or optional accessory is included.

S2 physical page 6 was visually reviewed at full page and in a 600 DPI contact-diagram crop. Populated markings: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24. Do not fill the unused body positions or renumber 1–12.

S3 printed B.86 male SCREW diagram and exact order row were visually reviewed. Comparing positions and counts with S2 makes 1 and 24 pilot/signal contacts; 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 16, 18, 20 and 22 are power contacts. S2 filled circles mark the two pilots; S3 open circles mark them. The tension-clamp diagram has a different orientation and is not substituted.

C.n and M.n are authoring aliases for the cable screw termination and mating end of manufacturer contact n. Each numbered contact is one passive conductor: explicitly author C.n–M.n factory-continuity jumpers in the project. Singleton bus functions and connector metadata do not join nets. Pilot designation does not introduce a switch inside this male insert, and no continuity to a separate mating device is implied.

PE is a single aggregate authoring endpoint for the documented protective-earth assembly. Individual screws, mating interfaces and metalwork continuity are unresolved. Do not add C.PE/M.PE, a central pin, housing bond or PE fixed link. required:true on PE is library policy; its presence check does not prove external protective bonding.

S1 DIN EN 61984 capability is 830 V, 20 A, 8 kV impulse at pollution severity 3; UL/CSA voltage is 600 V AC/DC. S2 specifies 500 V for signal contacts and 23 A legacy current; S3 says 20 A and supplies conductor/temperature-dependent derating curves. Hardware revision and reason for the change are unresolved; no scalar current, assigned nominal voltage or AC-only rating is authored.

S2 specifies main screw conductors 0.5–2.5 mm², 9 mm stripping, 0.5–0.55 Nm; PE 0.5–4 mm², 10 mm, 1.2–1.5 Nm. S1 includes 4 mm² maxima for some conductor forms while its general maximum is 2.5 mm²; installed revision and conductor preparation need review. No conductor size is selected.

No additional neutral, shield or communication interface is documented. Numbered poles are application-dependent and are not required. Shared endpoint policy permits representation of factory paths plus external wires; it does not authorize multiple field conductors under one screw.

connectionCoverage.notes: All twelve documented numbered contacts have separate cable and mating endpoints. PE is aggregate only: individual PE screw/mating positions and bonding paths remain unverified. C/M and textual PE are authoring aliases; no housing or accessory connections are asserted.
